info.name: Traveler's Guide to Elysia
info.description: Improved Studies for the Artist class in Aurora Builder.
info.author: Michael

description.p: Negative Space. You momentarily erase yourself from the surrounding composition.
Until the start of your next turn, you gain a +2 bonus to AC, and you can move up to half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
In addition, each creature of your choice within 5 feet of you must make a Dexterity saving throw.

ul.li: On a failed save, a creature takes 1d4 + your Wisdom modifier damage of your current Palette’s type.
On a successful save, the creature takes no damage.

sheet.description: Until the start of your next turn, you gain +2 AC and can move up to half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Creatures of your choice within 5 feet of you make a Dexterity save or take 1d4 + your Wisdom modifier damage of your current Palette’s type.

description.p: Overpaint. You overwhelm the battlefield with aggressive, layered expression.
Choose a point you can see within 30 feet. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw.

ul.li: On a failed save, a creature takes 2d6 + your Wisdom modifier damage of your current Palette’s type.
On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

description.p: If at least one creature fails its saving throw, you may immediately switch palettes without expending a palette switch.

sheet.description: Choose a point within 30 feet. Creatures in a 10-foot-radius sphere make a Dexterity save or take 2d6 + your Wisdom modifier damage of your current Palette’s type, or half as much on a success. If at least one creature fails, you may switch palettes without expending a palette switch.

description.p: Erase Boundary. You distort the composition of space itself.
Choose a 10-foot cube within 30 feet. Until the start of your next turn, the area becomes difficult terrain, and creatures inside the area can’t take reactions.
A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a Dexterity saving throw.

ul.li: On a failed save, it takes 1d4 damage of your current Palette’s type.
On a successful save, it takes no damage.

sheet.description: Choose a 10-foot cube within 30 feet. Until the start of your next turn, it becomes difficult terrain and creatures inside it can’t take reactions. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d4 damage of your current Palette’s type.
